name: disposition_assurance
description: Historical disposition assurance labels, retained for compatibility. Evidence strength is now evidence_grade E0-E3; human review is actor provenance, not an automatic evidence upgrade.

definitions.execution_proven: Historical claim of execution-backed assurance; use only an explicitly supplied evidence grade.
definitions.human_reviewed: Historical human-review provenance; human approval does not establish evidence strength.
definitions.machine_verified: Historical machine-verification provenance; no absent evidence grade may be inferred.
definitions.claimed: A bare claim, with no evidence grade.

standard.none: Project-defined classifier vocabulary; existing meanings are retained.

execution_proven.note: Use an explicitly supplied evidence grade only; do not guess a legacy grade.

human_reviewed.note: Retain the actor principal; human approval does not establish an evidence grade.

machine_verified.note: Use an explicitly supplied evidence grade only; do not guess a legacy grade.
